meta.source: MoSPI / International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS)
meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each round is a cross-section; the two rounds are compared by design but are never chained.
meta.coverage: NFHS table 14, anaemia among children and adults: All India and 36 states and union territories, total, rural and urban, NFHS-5, 2019-21
meta.fieldwork: June 2019 to April 2021, in two phases; the second, begun in January 2020, was interrupted by the pandemic
meta.note: One round of the National Family Health Survey, a cross-section: compare it with the other round side by side, never as a series. Every series is one sub-indicator in one place and sector. Values the fact sheet prints in brackets (an estimate on 25 to 49 unweighted cases) carry flags.caution (28 here). Cells suppressed at source ("*", fewer than 25 cases), marked NA or left blank are not baked; meta.omitted counts them.
meta.flagsNote: caution: the fact sheet prints this estimate in brackets, based on 25 to 49 unweighted cases. inconsistent: the source's total for this place does not lie between its rural and urban figures (flagNote says which).

nfhs4Withheld.sub: All women age 15-19 years who are anaemic
nfhs4Withheld.evidence: API 22.7 is NFHS-4's anaemia among men 15-49 (the NFHS-5 report, ch. 10: 23 per cent of men in 2015-16); women 15-19 were 54 per cent
